# Generalized_Synchronization_Bond

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A coupling condition where distinct network components achieve functional synchronization not through identical states but through a consistent functional mapping, forming a computational bond. This bond concept allows TCC to compose heterogeneous in-network processing elements into a unified computational fabric.
